description: Source code for MusicService class in an Android music player app, managing media playback, notifications, and media session integration.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: Android Service that handles music playback, notifications, and media session management.

classes.name: MusicService.LocalBinder
classes.description: Binder class to allow clients to bind to the MusicService.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes media session and creates notification channel.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel for the music controls notifications.

methods.name: setPlaylist
methods.description: Sets the playlist and starting index, then initiates playback.

methods.name: playSong
methods.description: Prepares and starts playback of the current song, updates media session and notification.

methods.name: updateMediaSession
methods.description: Updates media session with current song info and playback state.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays the media playback notification.

methods.name: createActionIntent
methods.description: Creates PendingIntent for notification action buttons.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles media control actions from notification.

methods.name: playPause
methods.description: Toggles playback state between play and pause.

methods.name: playNext
methods.description: Advances to the next song, shuffling if enabled.

methods.name: playPrevious
methods.description: Goes to the previous song in the playlist.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks media playback to specified position.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns total duration of current song.

methods.name: setRepeat
methods.description: Sets whether the current song should repeat.

methods.name: getAudioSessionId
methods.description: Returns the audio session ID for the media player.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media resources and media session.
